lines.text: Ziba brings David donkeys loaded with food and wine, saying the donkeys are for the king's household to ride.
Ziba says Mephibosheth stays in Jerusalem hoping to regain the kingdom, so David gives Ziba everything Mephibosheth owns.
Near Hebron, Shimei son of Gera curses David, throws stones at him and calls him a man of bloodshed.
Abishai asks to cut off Shimei's head, but David refuses because the LORD may have told Shimei to curse him.
Shimei keeps cursing and flinging dust from the valley of Elah, and David's company arrives exhausted and refreshes there.
